question: ENTRYJOB 的业务处理流程是什么？
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. ENTRYJOB.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 ROWS-PARAMS.
  05 ROWS-FUNCTION PIC X(8).
  05 ROWS-STATUS PIC X(4).
01 APPROVED PIC X.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    PERFORM 3000-READ.
    IF APPROVED = 'Y'
        PERFORM 2000-WRITE
    END-IF.
    GOBACK.
3000-READ SECTION.
    MOVE 'ADVANCE' TO ROWS-FUNCTION.
    CALL 'ROWSIO' USING ROWS-PARAMS.
2000-WRITE SECTION.
    MOVE 'STORE' TO ROWS-FUNCTION.
    CALL 'ROWSIO' USING ROWS-PARAMS.
manual:
# Record processing R1.0

## Processing stages

| Section | Meaning | Caution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 3000-READ | Obtain the request to review. | Execution depends on the caller. |
| 2000-WRITE | Request the approved change. | Stage numbering does not establish execution order. |

## Database I/O

CALL XXXXIO USING XXXX-PARAMS

The operation is selected by XXXX-FUNCTION.

### Operations

| Function | Meaning | Caution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ADVANCE | Request the following record. | Inspect the returned status. |
| STORE | Request an update. | A request is not a committed result. |

call_analysis.branch_conditions: 补充被调用方的某个返回结果时，保留该结果的完整条件：包括此前优先分支未命中及相关早退未发生。不能把后续拒绝范围写成主程序的可调用范围。

call_analysis.caller_outcomes: 解释跳过调用时，完整说明主程序自己的提前返回、实际 CALL、ON EXCEPTION 与正常返回分支及最终状态来源。先说明入口对相关状态和输出字段的初始化，再逐路径追踪赋值；提前返回时未再赋值的字段仍取该路径此前确定的值。VALUE 声明只说明初始化时的值，不代表每次调用都会重置。使用声明初值举例时明确以首次初始化或已知输入为前提；重复激活且 WORKING-STORAGE 保留时，不把未重新赋值的字段写成再次恢复初值。即使被调用实现有多个候选，主程序原文已经确定的调用与返回处理仍可直接说明。CALL 异常按异常分支解释，不能仅凭 ON EXCEPTION 推定被调用方必未进入。
call_analysis.parameter_scope: 追踪状态值从被调用方参数到调用方字段，再到调用方对外参数或返回值的路径。依据 PROCEDURE DIVISION USING、BY REFERENCE、BY CONTENT、BY VALUE、RETURNING 及显式赋值说明可见性；调用方自己的 WORKING-STORAGE 临时字段不因接收被调用返回参数就自动成为对外输出。
call_analysis.operation_status: 返回状态的含义以实际赋值和检查为准。涉及文件时，核对 OPEN、WRITE、CLOSE及其后的 FILE STATUS 检查；程序未检查或未传出的后续状态，不扩写成全部操作正常的保证。区分源码未显式设置、传出或检查返回状态与运行环境行为；不把未写 RETURNING 或未显式处理返回状态概括成没有返回码。
call_analysis.source_state: 使用当前原文及 callee_source_status。ambiguous 表示有多个实现候选，只限制被调用实现的结论；not_supplied 表示本轮未供应实现原文，不能据此声称仓库没有实现。

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. ENTRYJOB.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 ROWS-PARAMS.
  05 ROWS-FUNCTION PIC X(8).
  05 ROWS-STATUS PIC X(4).
01 APPROVED PIC X.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    PERFORM 3000-READ.
    IF APPROVED = 'Y'
        PERFORM 2000-WRITE
    END-IF.
    GOBACK.
3000-READ SECTION.
    MOVE 'ADVANCE' TO ROWS-FUNCTION.
    CALL 'ROWSIO' USING ROWS-PARAMS.
2000-WRITE SECTION.
    MOVE 'STORE' TO ROWS-FUNCTION.
    CALL 'ROWSIO' USING ROWS-PARAMS.
